```{r}
mh <- function(log_target, rprop, dprop = NULL, x0, iter = 2000) {
	x <- matrix(NA, iter + 1, length(x0))
	x[1, ] <- x0
	accepted <- 0

	for (i in 1:iter) {
		cur <- x[i, ]
		cand <- rprop(cur)

		r <- log_target(cand) - log_target(cur)
		if (!is.null(dprop)) {
			r <- r + dprop(cur, cand) - dprop(cand, cur)
		}

		if (log(runif(1)) < r) {
			x[i + 1, ] <- cand
			accepted <- accepted + 1
		} else {
			x[i + 1, ] <- cur
		}
	}

	list(
	     chain = drop(x),
	     acceptance_rate = accepted / iter
	)
}
```

```{r}
rjmcmc <- function(log_target, rprop, x0, iter = 2000L) {
	if (length(iter) != 1L || !is.finite(iter) ||
	    iter < 1 || iter != floor(iter)) {
		stop("iter must be a positive integer.")
	}

	chain <- vector("list", iter + 1L)
	chain[[1L]] <- x0
	current_log_target <- log_target(x0)

	if (length(current_log_target) != 1L ||
	    !is.finite(current_log_target)) {
		stop("The initial state must have a finite log target density.")
	}

	accepted <- logical(iter)
	moves <- character(iter)

	for (i in seq_len(iter)) {
		cur <- chain[[i]]
		proposal <- rprop(cur)
		cand <- proposal$state
		moves[i] <- proposal$move

		candidate_log_target <- log_target(cand)

		if (length(candidate_log_target) != 1L ||
		    is.na(candidate_log_target) ||
		    candidate_log_target == Inf) {
			stop("The candidate log target must be finite or -Inf.")
		}

		r <- candidate_log_target - current_log_target +
			proposal$log_reverse - proposal$log_forward +
			proposal$log_jacobian

		if (length(r) != 1L || is.na(r)) {
			stop("Invalid acceptance ratio; check proposal probabilities.")
		}

		if (log(runif(1L)) < r) {
			chain[[i + 1L]] <- cand
			current_log_target <- candidate_log_target
			accepted[i] <- TRUE
		} else {
			chain[[i + 1L]] <- cur
		}
	}

	list(
	     chain = chain,
	     model = vapply(chain, function(s) s$k, integer(1L)),
	     accepted = accepted,
	     move = moves,
	     acceptance_rate = mean(accepted),
	     acceptance_by_move = tapply(accepted, moves, mean)
	)
}
```

```{r}
test_rjmcmc_prior <- function(iter = 1e5L, kmax = 5L, lambda = 2,
			      mu = 1, s = 2, jacobian = TRUE, seed = 1) {
	set.seed(seed)

	log_target <- function(state) {
		dpois(state$k, lambda, log = TRUE) +
			sum(dnorm(state$theta, 0, 1, log = TRUE))
	}

	move_probs <- function(k) {
		if (k == 0L) {
			c(birth = 1, death = 0, update = 0)
		} else if (k == kmax) {
			c(birth = 0, death = 0.5, update = 0.5)
		} else {
			c(birth = 1 / 3, death = 1 / 3, update = 1 / 3)
		}
	}

	log_jac <- if (jacobian) log(s) else 0

	rprop <- function(cur) {
		k <- cur$k
		pr <- move_probs(k)
		move <- sample(names(pr), 1L, prob = pr)

		if (move == "birth") {
			u <- rnorm(1)
			list(
			     state = list(k = k + 1L, theta = c(cur$theta, mu + s * u)),
			     move = move,
			     log_forward = log(pr[["birth"]]) + dnorm(u, log = TRUE),
			     log_reverse = log(move_probs(k + 1L)[["death"]]),
			     log_jacobian = log_jac
			)
		} else if (move == "death") {
			u <- (cur$theta[k] - mu) / s
			list(
			     state = list(k = k - 1L, theta = cur$theta[-k]),
			     move = move,
			     log_forward = log(pr[["death"]]),
			     log_reverse = log(move_probs(k - 1L)[["birth"]]) +
				     dnorm(u, log = TRUE),
			     log_jacobian = -log_jac
			)
		} else {
			j <- sample.int(k, 1L)
			theta <- cur$theta
			theta[j] <- theta[j] + rnorm(1, 0, 0.5)
			list(
			     state = list(k = k, theta = theta),
			     move = move,
			     log_forward = 0, log_reverse = 0, log_jacobian = 0
			)
		}
	}

	out <- rjmcmc(log_target, rprop, list(k = 0L, theta = numeric(0)), iter)

	expected <- dpois(0:kmax, lambda)
	expected <- expected / sum(expected)
	observed <- tabulate(out$model + 1L, nbins = kmax + 1L) / length(out$model)
	k_check <- data.frame(
			      k = 0:kmax, expected = round(expected, 4), observed = round(observed, 4)
	)

	th1 <- unlist(lapply(out$chain, function(st) if (st$k >= 1L) st$theta[1]))

	list(
	     k_check = k_check,
	     max_abs_diff = max(abs(observed - expected)),
	     theta1_mean_sd = c(mean = mean(th1), sd = sd(th1)),
	     acceptance_by_move = out$acceptance_by_move
	)
}
```

```{r}
test_rjmcmc_prior()
```
